description: A custom implementation of a Set class in PHP providing basic set operations like add, remove, union, and membership testing.

classes.name: Set
classes.description: A class representing a collection of unique elements with set operations such as addition, removal, union, and membership checking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the set with an array of elements.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a value to the set.

methods.name: member
methods.description: Checks if a value is a member of the set.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Returns a new set that is the union of this set and another set.

methods.name: unionInPlace
methods.description: Modifies the current set to be the union with another set.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the set.
